title: Split the mask family into 4 tools + a black-and-white mask view
description:
Two UI changes agreed in the 2026-07-29 masking brainstorm that ship independently of both MPI-379 (hover/COCO) and MPI-380 (SAM3). No detection change, no new weight, no workflow change.

A. FOUR TOOLS, ONE JOB EACH. Today the brush rides along on the detect and points tools. Separate them: (1) Mask brush - brush + eraser only, nothing else; (2) Points - as it is today; (3) Object detection - face / hand / person / objects, no brush; (4) Shapes (MPI-368). The user goes to the brush tool to paint, and nowhere else. Rail modes today are maskDetect / maskPoints and the viewer only knows the canvas mode mask, so MpiGroupHistoryBlock._viewerModeFor bridges them - EVERY new mask tool must be added to _isMaskTool() or everything hanging off it silently misbehaves.

B. BLACK-AND-WHITE MASK VIEW. A new toggle between the invert-mask button and the trash button in MpiMaskStrip, showing the mask itself as plain black and white instead of a translucent overlay on the image. This is what lets a user find and erase stowaways - the stray specks a detection leaves behind. Native segm masks in particular come back with visible scatter.

Pulling the brush out of the detect tool also RETIRES an earlier MPI-379 decision: a third Select mode in MpiMaskStrip (Brush | Erase | Select) is no longer needed, because on a tool with no brush a canvas click is unambiguous.
acceptance: Four mask tools in the rail, each mounting only what it needs. MpiMaskStrip already takes brush:false - Points uses it today, Detect and Shapes should too
Every new tool is registered in _isMaskTool(); a mask tool must NOT swap the viewer surface (swapToPreview destroys MpiCanvas - it is a VRAM optimisation, not a display requirement)
A tool swap does NOT clear the mask. manualCanvas + subtractCanvas are the user work; only the auto layer is disposable. Nothing on a mount path may call clearMask()
destroy() on any tool that armed points MUST call setMaskPointsMode(false) or right-click stays broken app-wide
Settings still persist under the ONE mask tool key so they survive a tool swap
B/W toggle sits between invert and trash in MpiMaskStrip and renders the mask at full alpha - the opacity slider is inert in that mode rather than producing grey mush
B/W view composes with the existing display-only invert, so the two together show exactly what gets exported
The green auto-layer tint stays visible in B/W view, or pick state becomes invisible on the detect tool
The user can paint and erase while in B/W view - that is the entire point of it
New icon added to js/utils/icons.js (never paste raw SVG at the call site)
docs/masking.md updated (200-line cap, currently AT it - trim first)
